description: This horizontal bar chart, titled “Deceived,” illustrates the number of conversations categorized by whether the participants were deceived (“Yes,” red), deceived “Partially” (yellow), or not deceived (“No,” green), across four domains: Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism. The vertical axis lists these domains in descending order of total conversation count, from top to bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Conversations,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For Academic Collaboration, the red bar (“Yes”) extends to approximately 36, the yellow bar (“Partially”) to about 27, and the green bar (“No”) to around 7. In the Recruitment category, the red bar (“Yes”) reaches approximately 38, the yellow bar (“Partially”) to about 24, and the green bar (“No”) to around 7. For Academic Funding, the red bar (“Yes”) is the longest, extending to approximately 62, the yellow bar (“Partially”) to about 5, and the green bar (“No”) to around 3. In Journalism, the yellow bar (“Partially”) is the longest, reaching approximately 48, the red bar (“Yes”) to about 15, and the green bar (“No”) to around 7. The bars are not sorted by any specific criterion other than their position in the legend, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
